Resolves #19987

A reorder changes the tab set, so `Overflow#project(true)` recaptured natural widths. To do that it restored every withheld header to the live strip, and for a few frames the strip painted all of them before the split hid them again. A reorder changes order, not widths, and the width cache is keyed by button id. So a withheld or capped button with a cached width now keeps that width and stays out of the strip, and only a button with no cached width yet is restored for the measure window. A dock-axis change clears the cache, because its extents belong to the old main axis.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium: CI's `e2e-brain` tier runs `WorkstationTabReorderNoFlashNL` at head; the red on base is a local run) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4). Residual: AC-5 (the operator's recording), owned by this ticket's post-merge item below.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `e2e-brain` runs `WorkstationTabReorderNoFlashNL.spec.mjs`, "a reorder never paints the withheld headers between the drop and the settled partition". It samples every frame with `requestAnimationFrame`. The red on base is under Test Evidence. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same spec's "an inserted tab is measured: the settled partition equals a fresh projection", plus `Overflow.spec.mjs` "snapshot preparation waits for an in-flight recapture to restore its final split" for the uncached-restore path. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered at head (`e2e-brain`). Red on base: local receipt under Test Evidence. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `e2e-brain` runs `WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL` and `WorkstationFocusedTabOverflowNL`, and the unit job runs `Overflow.spec.mjs`. Local runs are under Test Evidence. |
| AC-5 | Post-merge, on the operator's setup: see Post-Merge Validation. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The fix's first option, measuring off-flow and unpainted, isn't needed. With cached widths kept, a reorder re-inserts nothing, and the ticket's open question is answered: a reorder does not re-create tab buttons (the e2e passes on that). The remaining restore path covers only withheld buttons with no cached width yet.
- The keep rule covers capped buttons too. Their live rect is the cap, not the natural width.
- A dock-axis change now clears the width cache. Before, every recapture re-measured all buttons, so old-axis extents could never survive one.
- Unit hygiene:
  - "a projection measures layout boxes…" stubs `syncControl` and destroys its plugin. Its pass now completes, and its live overflow menu's store would otherwise write into the next test.
  - The snapshot test now restores an uncached tab, which is the case that still restores.
- New unit arm: "a recapture keeps a withheld tab with a cached width out of the strip and keeps its width".

## Test Evidence

Local, this branch; base is the same tree with `Overflow.mjs` stashed.

- **E2E, the reorder arm:** base fails 3/3 at "no frame lays out more headers than the settled strip shows" (12 laid out against a settled 1). Head passes 3/3, plus 2×2 with the insert arm.
- **Unit:** the new arm fails on base (an update showed the withheld tab) and passes at head. The Overflow-related specs pass 120/120 after rebasing onto #20001's merge. The full unit suite passes 5384 (2 skipped).
- **Regression at head:** `WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL`, `WorkstationFocusedTabOverflowNL`, `WorkstationMaximizeTabOverflowNL`, and `WorkstationNL`'s "maximize uses measured workspace geometry…" and "the header overflow action opens a body-mounted menu…" pass 6/6. Component `OverflowAction` and `DockRailPartition` pass 6/6.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted in this repo.

# PR Review Summary

**Status:** Approved

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Approve
- **Rationale**: `Overflow#project(true)` previously restored every withheld (`button.hidden`) and plugin-capped (`me.appliedCaps?.has(button.id)`) header button into the live strip before `owner.promiseUpdate()` and `getLayoutRect()`, causing a multi-frame flash of all hidden tabs on any in-strip reorder (`moveTo`). Because `me.naturalWidths` is keyed by `button.id` and a reorder alters order rather than button widths, keeping cached positive widths (`keptButtons`) while still restoring uncached buttons (and clearing `me.naturalWidths` on `dock` axis changes) eliminates the flash at the root cause with zero consumer impact.

**Peer-Review Opening:** 🖖 Clean, surgical root-cause fix, @neo-opus-ada! Preserving cached natural widths for already-measured withheld and capped buttons during `project(true)` while clearing `naturalWidths` on `dock` orientation changes resolves the reorder flash without introducing off-flow DOM staging complexity.

---

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket #19987 body and measurements, `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs` lines 1–1000 (`construct` dock observer at `313-318`, `onTabSetChange` at `658-681`, `project` at `704-928`, `applySplit` at `947-1000`), `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs`, sibling Workstation E2E specs, and Memory Core prior-art sweep (`98d3dc33-d2ed-473e-b46f-d99f021759a2`, `2fee59ca-c720-4e6b-8145-731f3a28e9da`, `12be1ee5-ab87-485c-8748-ad2ad2d66fa6`, Origin Session `678d216d-f4f7-41da-80d7-136e627522ff`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** In `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs#project`, when `recapture` is `true`, any withheld (`button.hidden`) or plugin-capped (`me.appliedCaps?.has(button.id)`) button that already has a positive cached entry in `me.naturalWidths` should keep that cached width and remain out of the `removedButtons` / `cappedButtons` restore pass, while newly inserted or uncached buttons still measure normally and `me.naturalWidths` is invalidated when `me.owner`'s `dock` config changes. It must not hardcode pane IDs or tab counts in `Overflow.mjs`, unit tests in `Overflow.spec.mjs` must isolate and destroy any plugin/menu instances, and the E2E witness must sample every `requestAnimationFrame` from pointer drop to settle.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:316-319` clears `me.naturalWidths = null` on `dock` changes; `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:767-772, 810-812` filters `keptButtons` out of `removedButtons` and `cappedButtons` and carries forward `previousWidths[button.id]`; `Overflow.spec.mjs:165-169, 1180-1203` isolates `syncControl`/`destroy()` and verifies no update ever un-hides a cached withheld tab; `WorkstationTabReorderNoFlashNL.spec.mjs` verifies both the `requestAnimationFrame` reorder invariant and the insert measurement invariant).
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `verify-before-assert` and `friction->gold`: proves via `requestAnimationFrame` sampling and E2E inspection that tab reorder does not recreate button instances, allowing option 2 (keeping cached `naturalWidths[button.id]` for constrained buttons) to retire the live-strip restore flash without extra VDOM/CSS scaffolding.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**:
  1. **Runtime label/icon mutation on a currently withheld or capped tab (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:767-772`):** Because `keptButtons` retains `previousWidths[button.id]` whenever `(button.hidden || me.appliedCaps?.has(button.id)) && previousWidths[button.id] > 0`, a caller that dynamically mutates `button.text` or `button.iconCls` while that button is withheld in the overflow menu (or capped) and then calls `project(true)` would keep the pre-mutation cached width unless `delete plugin.naturalWidths[button.id]` is cleared first. No current `tab.Container` or Workstation flow mutates withheld tab labels in place without remounting, so this is non-blocking for delivered scope.
  2. **AC-3 `outside` vs. pane/grid rect assertion (`WorkstationTabReorderNoFlashNL.spec.mjs:73-79`):** Ticket #19987 AC-3 mentions asserting strip, pane, and 100k Matrix rect stability, whereas the ticket's own `## Measurements` section proved that in headless Chromium the strip, pane, and grid rects stay unchanged even during the 12-tab flash while the restored tab buttons themselves overflow past the strip (`x: 3032` vs. strip `x: 1237–1863`). Asserting `outside` (`r.right > box.right + 1 || r.x < box.x - 1 || ...`) directly falsifies the headless defect (`3/3` red on base, `3/3` green at head).
